The Village's traffic code formally addresses bicycles, electric bicycles, electric scooters, and electric personal assistive mobility devices (EPAMDs) such as Segways and hoverboards. The rules are designed to accommodate the growing popularity of these devices while ensuring the continued safety of pedestrians and riders throughout the Village. No Riding on Defined Business Area sidewalks. Along North Main Street (East Washington to Orange), North Franklin Street, River Street, West Street, and Plaza Drive, devices must be walked rather than ridden.
